hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -q 'apps/world-builder-ui/' && echo '[owned-scope] apps/world-builder-ui/ is app-engineer lane — verify dispatch context (app-engineer dispatch or operator override logged in dispatch record)' || true

bash -c 'cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) && if [ -n "$BRANCH" ] && [ "$BRANCH" != "main" ] && [ "$BRANCH" != "master" ] && ! echo "$BRANCH" | grep -Eq "^(feat|fix|docs|chore)/m[0-9]+-s[0-9]+-"; then echo "[delivery-standard] branch \"$BRANCH\" does not match feat/m<N>-s<N>-<desc>"; fi'

hooks.prompt: Before finishing this turn, the navigator (or operator on the navigator's behalf) should check three things and surface anything material: (1) Are there uncommitted changes in `git status --short`? If so, name them. (2) Is `docs/board/approval-dispatch-log.md` consistent with what actually happened this session — every dispatched task recorded, every closed task marked closed? (3) Is `docs/board/founder-approval-queue.md` current — any task that moved out of `approved` because it shipped, any new proposal that should rise? If anything is stale or unrecorded, prompt the operator to address it before the session ends.
